hypotheses.claim: Diarylnitro residual magnitude remains dependent on substitution and stereochemical context.
hypotheses.alternative: Current centers may generalize adequately across these diarylnitro variants.
hypotheses.learning_value: Separate transferable nitro residuals from local positional effects.

hypotheses.claim: Aryl methoxy substitution will leave fluorinated or substituted thioether centers overpredicted.
hypotheses.alternative: Recent mixed thioether residuals indicate no persistent positive signed-error direction.
hypotheses.learning_value: Test whether thioether overprediction persists after retraining.

hypotheses.claim: Short and long fluorinated imidazole chains will show scaffold-specific rather than monotonic retention transfer.
hypotheses.alternative: Chain length may produce a consistent retention trend at fixed recorded conditions.
hypotheses.learning_value: Resolve chain-length transfer after mixed short-chain residuals.

hypotheses.claim: Substituted cyclic ureas with high centers may retain longer than predicted, especially with polar aryl substituents.
hypotheses.alternative: The near-zero residual stereopair indicates current cyclic-urea centers are adequate.
hypotheses.learning_value: Separate substitution-driven cyclic-urea residuals from stereochemical effects.

hypotheses.claim: Near-zero enol centers will continue to underpredict retention across substituted diastereomers.
hypotheses.alternative: Observed low-center enols may represent a narrow local failure.
hypotheses.learning_value: Test persistence of low-center failure across new substitutions.

hypotheses.claim: High-center sulfonyl pyrrolidines will retain below their frozen centers across substitution variants.
hypotheses.alternative: Recent matched sulfonyl pairs may generalize with small residuals and small stereo gaps.

hypotheses.claim: Matched candidate stereopairs will show scaffold-specific ordering and often smaller gaps than predicted.
hypotheses.alternative: The current retrained stereochemical ordering may be broadly reliable.
hypotheses.learning_value: Add direct stereochemical supervision across distinct response levels.

hypotheses.claim: Distant oxygenated and fused topologies will expose residuals missed by nearest chemical controls.
hypotheses.alternative: Current centers may interpolate these high-coverage exploratory structures adequately.
hypotheses.learning_value: Broaden chemical supervision while retaining interpretable local contrasts.

response.feedback_interpretation: Historical labels support local, scaffold-dependent residual transfer. Diarylnitro and thioether directions remain substitution-sensitive. IPA effects transferred more clearly, while large stereochemical gaps often collapsed or reversed. Low-center failures persisted across several enol esters. Centers are MSE-trained predictions, widths are uncalibrated, and coverage is a raw-gradient distance percentile.
response.batch_rationale: All 3,986 candidates across all 14 pages were compared globally. The batch combines nitro and thioether constitutional controls, chain and cyclic-urea contrasts, low-center enol pairs, sulfonyl-pyrrolidine transfer, stereo controls, and distant oxygenated topology probes. Matching and condition contrasts were prioritized where historical contradictions were strongest.
unresolved_questions: Do new diarylnitro substitutions preserve mixed residual directions or reveal a transferable center bias?
Does thioether overprediction persist after methoxy and aryl-placement changes?
Can short and long imidazole chains establish any reproducible retention trend?
Do substituted cyclic ureas remain underpredicted despite an accurate stereopair?
Do low-center enol failures persist across heteroaryl and halogen variants?
Which sulfonyl-pyrrolidine substitutions retain below their centers?
Do new stereo pairs reproduce scaffold-specific ordering and collapsed gaps?
Which distant oxygenated topologies transfer beyond nearest labeled neighborhoods?
